'''Business and economy'''
*The [[United States Department of Transportation]] fines the [[Germany|German]] airline [[Lufthansa]] $4 million for its mistreatment of [[Orthodox Judaism|Orthodox]] [[Jews|Jewish]] passengers during a flight from [[New York (state)|New York]] to [[Hungary]] through Germany in 2022. '''Disasters and accidents'''

**The [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]] sends a letter to the [[Thirty-seventh government of Israel|Israeli government]], urging it to take action to improve the [[Gaza humanitarian crisis (2023–present)|humanitarian crisis]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] within 30 days. **The [[European Union]] sanctions fourteen [[Iran]]ian individuals and firms, including [[Iran Air]] and several high-ranking members of the [[Quds Force]], for allegedly transferring missiles and drones to [[Moscow]] in order to help [[Russia]] in its [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2024/10/15/eu-sanctions-iran-over-alleged-missile-transfers-to-russia (Al Jazeera)]
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] announces that it has destroyed portions of an unused road that linked North Korea with [[South Korea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/north-korea-roads-destroys-drones-south-0672f5baf033cf0c4ecb2f1e1b958a41 (AP)]
*[[Philippines–United Arab Emirates relations]]
**Following a phone call with [[President of the United Arab Emirates|Emirati president]] Sheikh [[Mohamed bin Zayed]], [[Philippine president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] confirms that 143 [[Filipinos in the United Arab Emirates]] have been [[pardon]]ed by the [[Government of the United Arab Emirates|Emirati government]].
